{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

dd = open('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/data_dictionary.md', 'r').read()

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_deduped = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = trial_df_deduped[trial_df_deduped['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0].shape[0]
print(f'Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Remove rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
trial_df_clean = trial_df_deduped[trial_df_deduped['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check response rate by arm
response_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by arm (after cleaning):')
print(response_by_arm)

# Check baseline severity imbalance
severity_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print('\nBaseline severity by arm (after cleaning):')
print(severity_by_arm)

# Compute change in biomarker
trial_df_clean['biomarker_change'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_final'] - trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Check if biomarker improved (change > 0)
biomarker_improved = trial_df_clean['biomarker_change'] > 0
print('\nProportion of patients with biomarker improvement:')
print(biomarker_improved.mean())

# Stratify by arm
print('\nBiomarker improvement by arm:')
print(trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean())

# Check if improvement is significant within arms
print('\nMean biomarker change by arm:')
print(trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean())

# Check if arm assignment is confounded by severity
print('\nSeverity distribution by arm:')
print(trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True))"}
